name: The Sticks
source:
A group of college students are brought together during the summer to fix up an old highschool, as part of the college's new plan to expand to other campuses without spending the money on construction. Each of the students all owe a debt to the college, finding themselves under community service for one reason or another. Either that, or they go to jail.

[From [url=https://sockeyesalmon.itch.io/the-sticks-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学为了扩建校区又省下施工费，想出了一个新计划。暑假，一群大学生被叫来修缮一所老旧的高中。这些学生人人有事亏欠学校，各有各的原因，不得不来做社区服务。否则，他们就得蹲监狱。

［摘自[url=https://sockeyesalmon.itch.io/the-sticks-demo]itch.io[/url]］
